Disassembled the shipped vccorlib120_app!InitializeData (RVA 0x20224): arg 0 -> skip, arg 1 -> RoInitialize(0) (STA), any other (2) -> RoInitialize(1) (MTA); literal cell 0x230DC = api-ms-win-core-winrt-l1-1-0!RoInitialize.
